entries.title: Anthropic Research: Contextual Retrieval & Prompt-Cached BM25 + Embedding Hybrid RAG
entries.summary: Prepending chunk-specific explanatory context before embedding + BM25 reduces top-20 retrieval failure rates by 67% while cutting latency via KV prompt caching.

entries.title: Anthropic Engineering: Claude Code Best Practices & Sub-Agent Context Isolation
entries.summary: How to structure CLAUDE.md constitutions, scoped MCP tool permissions, pre-commit verification hooks, and sub-agent context isolation to prevent context rot.

entries.title: Anthropic Engineering: Building Effective Agents — Composable Workflows vs Autonomous Harnesses
entries.summary: Production engineering breakdown showing why simple composable workflows (routing, orchestrator-workers, evaluator-optimizer) outperform unconstrained agent frameworks in enterprise reliability.

entries.title: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
entries.summary: We asked Claude to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet. The prototypes worked without any fixes to their circuitry.

entries.title: Mistral AI Engineering: High-Throughput Sparse MoE & Structured Function Calling at Scale
entries.summary: Deploying low-latency tool-calling and deterministic JSON schema enforcement across regulated VPC boundaries with quantized KV-cache paging.
